title: Build public bounded Codex-to-Grok Bot MCP integration
description: Deliver a public Vault-backed local MCP server with bounded source snapshots, untrusted patch validation, shared worker coordination, and explicit release gates.
acceptance_criteria: Public GitFlow delivery passes unit, contract, security, and staged live acceptance with no private deployment data in Git.

title: Public bootstrap and hygiene
description: Public package metadata, documentation, CI, and staged/history hygiene checks.
notes:
Pinned GHCR Gitleaks image probe returned registry denied on the development host. CI now uses the upstream Go module at v8.30.1 with its declared Go 1.24.11 toolchain; scanner semantics are unchanged. Local Gitleaks 8.30.1 scans passed.
Public bootstrap PR #1 CI passed: Python test and Gitleaks full-history jobs. Local six tests, Ruff, YAML, Beads integrity, external denylist and Gitleaks also passed. Local Go 1.19 could not build the pinned Go 1.24.11 module; hosted CI validated that exact workflow.
close_reason: Public bootstrap validated in PR #1; ready to merge into develop.

title: Protocol and workspace TDD
description: Test and implement bounded snapshots, path policy, artifacts, patch validation, and drift detection.
notes:
TDD red: local contract import failed before implementation. Green/refactor: 23 tests pass, including v1/v2 correlation, dirty snapshots, workspace drift, exact declared/actual paths, write-path limits, traversal, sensitive/binary/symlink sources, and disposable patch application. Ruff check/format and local public scans pass.
PR #2 hosted test and full-history Gitleaks checks passed. The local contract milestone is accepted for develop; no live integration has been attempted.
close_reason: Local protocol and workspace validation passed in PR #2.

title: Vault credentials and CAS lease TDD
description: Test and implement Vault-only credential reads and shared KV v2 CAS lease lifecycle.
notes:
TDD red: Vault module import failed; additional red cases covered unreadable reconciliation and dotted Vault paths. Green/refactor: fake Vault HTTP tests cover AppRole file permissions, fresh login per operation, CAS acquire/renew/release, races, stale active leases, missing CAS metadata, ambiguous writes, and token denial. Local full suite has 37 passing tests. Live AppRole, policy/metadata provisioning, and cross-dispatcher proof remain outstanding; keep task open.
Live prerequisite discovered: Vault CLI has VAULT_CACERT, but Python urllib does not automatically use it. Add explicit CA bundle support with TLS verification and test before GitHub code.
Live dedicated AppRole exact credential reads and CAS metadata passed; neighboring credential and lease-key capabilities denied. A no-webhook CAS claim/release passed, followed by bidirectional contention between the real public and existing dispatcher implementations on the shared key. Lease readback is available. Existing production runtime still runs an older revision, so no shared-worker canary is permitted yet.
close_reason: Vault-only exact-path AppRole and KV v2 CAS contract proved live and accepted; installed existing-dispatcher guard remains cgm-1.7.

comments.author: Brian Charbonneau
comments.text: 2026-09-22: Operator accepted the completed lease source/live-CAS milestone. Dedicated AppRole exact-path access, CAS metadata, claim/release, and bidirectional public/existing-dispatcher contention were proven without a webhook. The running existing dispatcher still has an older revision; installation and installed-guard proof remain cgm-1.7, and live canaries remain cgm-1.8.

title: GitHub control and webhook TDD
description: Test and implement scoped App tokens, artifact retrieval, webhook dispatch, and revocation.
notes:
Existing dispatcher lease source is merged in its private repository. Public GitHub and webhook implementation remains gated by live Python Vault TLS and exact App installation checks.
Verified Python TLS against Vault with configured CA; exact control-repository installation token probe showed only requested permissions and sufficient lifetime, then token was revoked. Public GitHub/webhook TDD proceeds.
Local TDD covered exact token scope, expiry, revocation, immutable draft-PR artifact reads, HTTPS webhook uncertainty, explicit CA validation, and real in-memory JWT signing. Provider installation scope was independently verified with a revoked short-lived probe token. Live webhook canary remains a separate release gate.
close_reason: Scoped GitHub and webhook transport merged to develop in PR #5; 49 local tests and hosted test/secret scan passed. Live canary remains a separate gate.

title: Async MCP and durable state TDD
description: Test and implement stdio MCP tools, SQLite state, nonblocking dispatch, and restart reconciliation.
notes: Begin with dependency-free non-secret SQLite job state and restart recovery contract; MCP SDK dependency approval is pending.
close_reason: All seven async MCP source children merged to develop; 109 local tests and public CI passed. Live worker qualification remains cgm-1.7 and cgm-1.8.

comments.author: Brian Charbonneau
comments.text: 2026-09-22: All seven source children are closed. PR #12 merged to public develop at f3b42c5 after 109 local tests, Ruff, external denylist, Gitleaks, and both CI checks. Stdio tools, durable journal, bounded one-shot coordinator, restart uncertainty, and pinned patch retrieval are in source. Live guard installation and v2 canaries remain cgm-1.3/cgm-1.7/cgm-1.8.

title: Persist non-secret jobs and restart decisions
description: TDD a local SQLite job journal that stores only non-secret identifiers, source hashes, dispatch coordinates, timestamps, and state. Enforce private filesystem permissions, atomic state transitions, restart reconciliation, and workspace drift checks before later MCP orchestration.
acceptance_criteria: SQLite permissions and schema validate; states survive reopen; dirty-workspace digest conflict and uncertain dispatch restart fail closed.
notes:
TDD red: missing journal module, then lease-owner and exact-coordinate tests. Green/refactor: seven focused tests pass; private SQLite permissions, non-secret records, state transitions, restart uncertainty, queued restart, and workspace drift are covered. MCP boot must call reconcile_restart before dispatch.
Additional red/green test rejects an existing unversioned SQLite file rather than silently replacing its schema; full suite now has 57 passing tests.
close_reason: Journal contract and documentation implemented; seven focused tests pass.

title: Build bounded coding packet with advisory effort
description: TDD a pure v2 packet builder that preserves proven v1 webhook routing fields, sends only selected source snapshots, fixes worker instructions, binds job identity and artifact coordinates, and treats effort as advisory with no model selection.
acceptance_criteria: Packet tests cover exact source selection, no local paths, legacy route fields, write paths, artifact identity, size limit, and invalid effort or coordinates.
notes: TDD red: packet module absent, invalid control-repo path accepted, and two jobs could reuse one branch. Green/refactor: v2 packet preserves proven v1 route fields, sends selected snapshots only, enforces fixed 45-minute and no-workaround instructions, rejects large effort and oversized packets, and journal adds unique branch/artifact indexes. Full public suite: 68 passing tests. Live v2 webhook behavior remains a separate canary gate.
close_reason: Bounded packet and branch uniqueness implemented with 68 public tests passing.

title: Load explicit workers and workspace opt-in
description: TDD a stdlib TOML config loader with Vault-only credentials, exact per-worker webhook/App/lease paths, private local file permissions, and per-workspace allowlists. No automatic worker fallback or model selector.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover multiple workers, deny-by-default workspaces, disallowed worker, duplicate lease keys, unknown fields, unsafe config permissions, and missing required paths.
notes: TDD red: configuration module absent; a Path argument mismatch was caught by focused tests and fixed. Green/refactor: eight tests pass for two explicit workers, deny-by-default workspace grants, disabled workspace, duplicate lease keys, unknown backend/model fields, missing paths/CA, and private file permissions. Uses stdlib tomllib only. Generalized example and docs added; no actual workspace is opted in or job dispatched.
close_reason: Strict Vault-only multi-worker and workspace opt-in config contract implemented.

title: Persist worker token expiry before dispatch
description: TDD non-secret worker token expiry persistence in the SQLite job journal, require expiry before dispatching, preserve it through restart uncertainty, and migrate existing schema-v1 journals safely.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover expiry timing, dispatch transition guard, reopen and uncertain restart persistence, schema-v1 migration, and rejection of repeated or naive timestamps.
notes: TDD red: no token expiry field/API and dispatch transition allowed without durable expiry. Green/refactor: schema-v2 migration, timezone-aware >=50-minute token-expiry record, >=45-minute dispatch guard, and restart retention. Both queued and in-flight schema-v1 migration cases validated; in-flight becomes uncertain. Full public suite 80 passing tests; no token value persisted.
close_reason: Non-secret token expiry and fail-closed schema migration implemented with 80 public tests passing.

title: Serve real read-only job status over stdio MCP
description: Add the official Python MCP SDK and implement protocol-tested stdio status and active-worker tools against the private job journal and Vault lease. Do not expose delegation or result tools until their complete coordinator contract is ready. Keep README explicit about partial status.
acceptance_criteria: Red/green/refactor tests use the official MCP client against the real server; status and active report durable non-secret states, startup reconciles uncertain jobs, and protocol wire stays clean. Ruff, pytest, public denylist, staged and history Gitleaks pass.
close_reason: Read-only official-SDK stdio status and active-worker tools validated: five protocol tests including real subprocess, 85 full tests, Ruff, public denylist, staged and history Gitleaks. Delegation and live canary remain separate tracked work.

comments.author: Brian Charbonneau
comments.text: 2026-09-22: Official MCP SDK v2 approved and added. TDD red: missing server module; later red: a free Vault lease masked an uncertain local job. Green: official Client protocol tests cover status, active lease, Vault failure, restart reconciliation, and real stdio subprocess; full pytest 85 passed. Ruff check/format, diff check, and external public denylist passed. No live dispatch, Vault mutation, patch retrieval, or credential use. Staged/history Gitleaks and PR delivery remain.

title: Pin validated artifact identity in private journal
description: Persist the validated control-repository immutable head SHA and canonical artifact digest as non-secret journal state. Migrate schema v1 and v2 without losing jobs. Refuse mutable or missing artifact identity before terminal ready; preserve it across stdio restart for exact result retrieval. Source-only and fake-service tests; no live worker.
acceptance_criteria: TDD red/green/refactor covers schema v1/v2 migration, immutable identity recording, duplicate or malformed rejection, readiness gate, and restart preservation. Full pytest, Ruff, public denylist, staged/history Gitleaks, and CI pass. PR targets develop; main waits for milestone acceptance.
close_reason: Schema-v3 artifact identity and fail-closed migration complete: 19 journal tests, 90 full tests, Ruff, public denylist, and staged/history Gitleaks passed. Coordinator result retrieval remains a separate dependent task.

comments.author: Brian Charbonneau
comments.text: 2026-09-22: TDD red showed no artifact identity/readiness gate and schema-v2 ready state was not demoted; a second red showed no canonical digest API. Green: schema v3 pins immutable head SHA and canonical SHA-256 only in artifact_received, rejects replacement/invalid data, blocks validated/ready without identity, and demotes legacy unpinned terminal states to uncertain. Journal tests 19 passed; full suite 90 passed before a SQL-only layout fix; targeted journal tests and Ruff gates passed after the fix. No live worker or Vault mutation. Publication scans and PR remain.

title: Implement bounded delegate and pinned result lifecycle
description: Wire the existing strict config, source snapshot, v2 packet, Vault KV v2 CAS lease, scoped GitHub control transport, webhook, and private journal into a nonblocking stdio delegate/result coordinator. Dispatch once; renew while polling; cap at 45 minutes; retain ambiguous outcomes and timeouts without lease release. Validate and pin the returned artifact before release. Return only a revalidated patch for Codex-owned review and apply. Source-only fake-service proof; no live worker until installed dispatcher lease guard.
acceptance_criteria: TDD red/green/refactor covers opt-in, dirty/drifted workspace, busy/CAS lease, token expiry, ambiguous webhook, successful artifact, declared/actual path rejection, timeout, restart recovery, immutable result read, and no secret leakage. Official SDK in-process and stdio protocol tests pass. Full pytest, Ruff, public denylist, staged/history Gitleaks, and CI pass. PR merges to develop; main and live canary remain gated.
close_reason: Bounded source coordinator and official stdio tools validated: 109 pytest, Ruff, public denylist, staged/history Gitleaks, and PR CI test/secret-scan passed. PR #12 to develop is mergeable; live canary and main promotion remain gated.

comments.author: Brian Charbonneau
comments.text: 2026-09-22: TDD red captured missing coordinator/tools, queued-restart uncertainty, workspace disappearance, and transient result-read classification. Green: 109 full pytest tests, official SDK in-process and real stdio protocol, Vault CAS/busy/renewal, webhook ambiguity, token lifetime, dirty workspace drift, declared/actual path mismatch, timeout, restart recovery, immutable artifact identity and reread. Ruff check/format and external public denylist passed. No live webhook request. Staged scans, CI, and PR merge remain.

Source milestone complete; live shared-worker canary and main promotion remain separate gated work.
